message.content:
The illustration features the magazine masthead "TEMPO" in large red capital letters at the top. Above it, smaller text reads "LIPUTAN KHUSUS HARI KARTINI:" and "KEPAHLAWANAN EMMY SAELAN" alongside a small grayscale portrait of a woman. Below, the main graphic is a large profile of a person's head, formed entirely by hundreds of tiny, hand-drawn black-and-white human figures. These figures are densely packed to create the head’s silhouette, hair, and facial features. Some figures outside the main shape appear to be walking or standing alone. 

Near the bottom right, large black text reads "AGAMA DAN LUKA PILKADA". The bottom left corner contains a barcode and text reading "24-30 APRIL 2017" and "RP 45.000". The entire composition is set against a white background with a thick red border on the left and bottom edges. The human figures within the central shape are depicted in various poses, some carrying objects or interacting, though their individual features are minimal. The overall image is a composite formed by a multitude of small parts.
